FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 184
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Larry Stutts
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/27/2026
Senate Bill 184 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Department
of Human Resources (DHR) by an undetermined amount to develop and implement a dementia
training program to be completed by DHR employees and contractors that investigate adults in
need of care and protection as provided by this bill.
